Show: Oakley Meta on a two-hour outdoor test

Two hours outside with the Oakley Meta frames: one walk, one build check, one call. Short results, no spec talk.

✳Git-FEDPublished 2026-11-13Meta Glasses ↗2 min read

Two hours outside with the Oakley Meta frames: one walk, one build check, one call. Short results, no spec talk.

The test

Morning walk on an exposed path with steady wind, a stop to photograph a build detail, and a ten minute call at the halfway point.

What held up

Photos were quick and the framing was easier than with the Wayfarer because the shape sits closer to the eye line. The call was clear on my end the whole time.

What did not

Wind. The other side heard it for the first minute until I turned so the wind was behind me. Battery dropped more than I expected with photos plus a call in one session.

Would I use them for this again

Yes for photos outdoors. For calls on a windy path, I would still take them off and use the phone. That is not a knock on the frames, it is what an open mic does outside.
